title: Charlie Kirk’s Assassination Reminds Us That All This Violence Has To Stop!

content_html_sanitized:
A month ago today, I wrote a column about the late Charlie Kirk’s opposition to rescheduling cannabis.

See Charlie Kirk, Big Time “Christian Nationalist”, Wants Trump to Keep Cannabis In Schedule One, So Kids Won’t Have To Smell Smoke In The Park. Jesus Wept

 

Political assassinations have been disastrous for America, and I urgently hope that the gunman is quickly brought to justice. Whatever one may think of Kirk, there is no justification for this act.

 

I have been civilly debating people I disagree with for over sixty five years, including some absolutely obnoxious narcs, so I really thought that I would enjoy debating him.

“Now, Charlie!”

 

But let’s be very clear.

By arguing that cannabis should be kept in Schedule One, Kirk was advocating state violence against sick and dying Americans. Or, at the very least, that his fellow Americans should be deprived of medicine that is available in many other countries around the world, including Canada, the Czech Republic, The Netherlands, and even the very Prohibitionist UK.

 

His reason for this? So children wouldn’t have to smell smoke in the park.

 

And remember the Drug War, which was mostly about marijuana prohibition! There have been more than thirty million arrests in the last fifty years.

From 2000, The Theory and Practice of Chaos Analysis By Richard Cowan

 

And from Rolling Stone, 2023, CHARLIE KIRK SAYS A ‘PATRIOT’ SHOULD BAIL OUT ALLEGED PAUL PELOSI ATTACKER “The right-wing troll smirkingly alluded to a homophobic conspiracy theory about the home invasion.”

 

Sew the wind. Reap the whirlwind. This has to stop!

 

The Second Coming

BY WILLIAM BUTLER YEATS

Turning and turning in the widening gyre  

The falcon cannot hear the falconer;

Things fall apart; the centre cannot hold;

Mere anarchy is loosed upon the world,

The blood-dimmed tide is loosed, and everywhere  

The ceremony of innocence is drowned;

The best lack all conviction, while the worst  

Are full of passionate intensity.

 

Surely some revelation is at hand;

Surely the Second Coming is at hand.  

The Second Coming! Hardly are those words out  

When a vast image out of Spiritus Mundi

Troubles my sight: somewhere in sands of the desert  

A shape with lion body and the head of a man,  

A gaze blank and pitiless as the sun,  

Is moving its slow thighs, while all about it  

Reel shadows of the indignant desert birds.  

The darkness drops again; but now I know  

That twenty centuries of stony sleep

Were vexed to nightmare by a rocking cradle,  

And what rough beast, its hour come round at last,  

Slouches towards Bethlehem to be born?
